notes.title: Major update inbound!
notes.notes: updating to the new engine update I ran into some issues but got them ironed out, i had to rework some of the core framework but I believe you will like the changes got some amazing new features and highly requested additions and features, including hit markers / fixed to screen ammo count, new additions you will like I'm sure. improved visuals, new sliding animations and gun play animations and sounds, just all around more smooth and sleek menu /User interface. there will be some new maps I am trying to get the old maps ported over from the previous engine version, so if you have any favorites let my staff in the discord know or let me know and I will make sure to get those in. the game download size may change but shouldn't be by much, i am aiming at latest  next week could be sooner, thank you for the support!

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.notes:
Launch
Update 0.6.1

Welcome to Danger Horizon

Launch Update 0.6.1 is live, and thank you all for becoming part of the community
and becoming part of the future of Danger Horizon! i look forward to meeting everyone
on the battlefield, If its fighting in PVP or fighting against the tides of zombies, all multiplayer is peer to peer at the moment. if you start a match in multiplayer others will see the lobby.
you can look forward to upcoming updates which will include bug fixes, new maps, character skins,
and weapons, i welcome all those that like multiplayer to join the discord and join in
on community game days where we can plan strategy and arrange matches.
If you find any bugs during game-play please make a ticket in the discord and my admins or I
will work on reported bugs. as i am the only developer of the game as of this update
fixes may take a little while to implement changes/fix bugs. I want to make it clear
that this game is very important to me and i am constantly testing and developing for a better
experience and with the help of you and the community i know we will get there. ~ Developer Miller

notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.notes: Update 0.6 is up and running, Fixed a few bugs and made some map changes , new additions to a few maps and optimization - better fps and visual clarity. Thank you all for playing and if you find any bugs please report the finds in the discord ticket system. - Developer Miller

notes.title: update 0.5
notes.notes: bug/fixes and some optimization has been done for improved frame rate. follow the discord for more.
